messages:
Ivy L.: Quick spike idea 1: replace the large role modal with a lightweight 'role ledger' that slides up from the row. Keeps context, shows billing impact, and surfaces SSO locks inline. Proto: https://www.figma.com/file/ledger/proto :thought_balloon:

Marco D.: Love the context preservation. Two practical asks: 1) make sure the ledger overlay is anchored and doesn't reflow the table, 2) surface a tiny billing chip like '+1 billed' or 'no charge'.

Zoe W.: Copy suggestion: primary actions should be 'Set role' (in-org) and 'Invite & add' (external). Avoid words like 'grant' which are ambiguous. Also include short helper text under the action: 'No email will be sent' for Set role.

Aran K.: Accessibility notes: ledger should be a focusable region with role=dialog semantics, trap focus, Esc to close. Arrow keys to move between role options. Locked SSO options must be aria-disabled and expose the reason via aria-describedby.

Samira R.: Contrast/focus: ensure selected option meets 4.5:1. Toasts must use role=status and aria-live=polite so screen readers get updates without stealing focus. Undo button in the toast needs visible focus styling.

Ivy L.: Audit requirement: whenever a change is made through the ledger emit a structured event with method 'role_ledger'. We should deep-link from the ledger entry to the audit rail so support can jump to the exact row. Audit example for devs:

{ "event":"role.change", "actor":"ivy.l@redwood.com", "target":"sara@acme.com", "from":"Guest", "to":"Power", "method":"role_ledger", "ts":"2025-10-01T12:34:00Z" }

Marco D.: UX edge: when Invite & add is selected, show a confirmation popover with the email preview + billing impact before sending. Also hold billing finalization for 10s with an undo toast.

Zoe W.: microcopy for toast: 'Changed Sara to Power  Undo' (keep it short). For the ledger helper: 'Set role (no email)' and 'Invite & add (sends email)'.

Aran K.: I'll draft the keyboard map and accessibility checklist tonight. Focus order should be: row -> open ledger -> options (arrow) -> confirm -> toast receives aria-live update.

Samira R.: I'll run a Figma a11y pass once it's uploaded, testing VoiceOver + NVDA and high-contrast modes. Report any contrast or focus issues back into the prototype.

AuditBot: Inserted sample audit entry into dev index for testing: role.change (method=role_ledger) 2025-10-01 12:34:00Z.

Ivy L.: Thanks team  will update the figma and tag you when ready for review in Friday's design sync.
